description: ACH payments through Stripe (R6): three per-request-keyed StripeConnector methods (F7), the enabled-only portal connector factory, PortalPaymentAttemptStore, PortalPaymentService.create with replay rules and the F2 advisory-lock Transaction A and F4 supersede rules, GET /payment-attempts/{id}, the metadata-routed webhook branch, PortalPaymentReconciler with _ensure_recorded_and_applied (F8), the invoice-detail payment_attempt field, the runbook, and the full PAY-* test set. Design §3.1 (factory), §5 (payment_attempt label), §6, F2, F4, F7, F8, DV3, DV8. The payment area is FROZEN: implement exactly as written; accept or backlog non-HIGH edge cases. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-004.
steps: 1. integrations/stripe_connector.py: add create_portal_ach_intent(amount_cents, *, idempotency_key, metadata, description) (payment_method_types=['us_bank_account'], payment_method_options us_bank_account verification_method automatic, returns {id, client_secret, status}), cancel_intent(pi_id), retrieve_intent(pi_id), and get_publishable_key() if absent. Each decrypts the tenant envelope and passes api_key= per request inside asyncio.to_thread; never assigns stripe_sdk.api_key and never logs the key. Existing methods unchanged (B6).

2. bootstrap/agents.py: right after _stripe_connector_factory (~line 1900) add _portal_stripe_connector_factory (enabled instances only; None when none / repo or vault missing / lookup raises with WARN) and call portal.services.portal_payment_service.configure_portal_payments(connector_factory=..., payment_service=...) next to configure_stripe_endpoints, which also receives portal_payment_handler=reconciler.handle.

3. portal/services/portal_payment_service.py: PORTAL_CREATING_STALE_SECONDS = 120, injectable clock, PortalPaymentAttemptStore (every query WHERE tenant_id AND customer_id; get by id -> 404 otherwise; newest attempt per invoice), _portal_intent_body(attempt, invoice_number) as the ONLY body builder, and PortalPaymentService.create implementing design §6.2 steps 1-4 exactly: gates (404 invoicing, 409 PORTAL_PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE), replay check, Transaction A with pg_advisory_xact_lock('portal-pay:'||tenant||':'||invoice), step 1b same-key re-check incl. stale-creating re-drive, invoice read fresh, 409 INVOICE_NOT_PAYABLE, 422 PAYMENT_AMOUNT_INVALID with details.max_cents, FOR UPDATE in-flight check with pending/young-creating 409 PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS and created/stale-creating supersede (10 s bounded cancel; unexpected_state + processing/succeeded retrieve -> pending + 409; other error -> rollback + 502), INSERT creating, then Stripe create bounded 10 s with key portal_pa_<attempt_id> and conditional post-Stripe UPDATEs WHERE status='creating'. Header Idempotency-Key 8-255 [A-Za-z0-9_-] else 400 MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.

4. portal/api/payment_endpoints.py: POST /api/portal/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments (payment limit; body {amount_cents?} extra='forbid'; 201/200 shapes per §6.2; Retry-After: 2 on the creating replay) and GET /api/portal/payment-attempts/{payment_attempt_id} (read limit; include_client_secret strict bool default false; secret only for the attempt's actor_user_id when status created; retrieve error -> 502). Wire the invoice detail's payment_attempt field (FEAT-004 left it null) to PortalPaymentAttemptStore with the R6.13 labels, and make payable respect payments_available.

5. portal/services/portal_payment_reconciler.py PortalPaymentReconciler.handle(path_tenant_id, event) per §6.3: null-safe dict access, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE by metadata payment_attempt_id, tenant/customer/invoice/PI verification (mismatch -> WARN webhook_mismatch, no write, handled false), null PI fill, the transition table, _ApplyRejected, _event_type, and _ensure_recorded_and_applied verbatim from the design (find_by_external_id -> ingest -> payment_applied event check -> payable/reversed/remaining checks -> invoice_service.apply_payment; never PaymentService.apply), apply_rejected branch, late-success WARN, refund/dispute WARN only. integrations/api/stripe_endpoints.receive_stripe_webhook: portal branch after signature verification and BEFORE the existing try/except around handle_webhook_event; charge.refunded / charge.dispute.created try the portal handler first and fall through when not a portal attempt; configure_stripe_endpoints gains portal_payment_handler=None.

DEVIATIONS / CHOICES (minor, recorded for review)
- D-F5-1 The create response is the envelope {data: {payment_attempt_id, status_code, amount_cents, client_secret, publishable_key}, request_id} (fields per §6.2 inside the usual single-item envelope). client_secret/publishable_key are null on replays without a secret.
- D-F5-2 A replay without amount_cents matches any stored amount (the default is remaining_cents, only known after the invoice read); with an amount it must equal the stored one, else 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
- D-F5-3 Step 2 skips the plain replay for a same-key row that is stale `creating`, so step 1b (under the lock) re-drives it; otherwise the 121 s case would answer the creating replay forever.
- D-F5-4 Errors decided inside Transaction A after a write (the money-moving 409, the 1b re-drive failure 502) are returned out of the transaction and raised after commit (_Deferred), so the write isn't rolled back. The cancel-failure 502 is raised inside the transaction, so it rolls back as designed.
- D-F5-5 When a supersede re-drive fails, the stale row goes to failed/provider_error and a WARN 'portal_payment_redrive_failed' is logged (not the ERROR provider line), then creation continues, per §6.2.
- D-F5-6 inflight_for_update and the store reads also filter customer_id (stricter than the design's tenant+invoice). The advisory lock key is tenant+invoice as designed.
- D-F5-7 GET /payment-attempts/{id}?include_client_secret=true by another user of the same customer answers 404 (the design says the secret is only for the actor; 404 keeps it indistinguishable from unknown). Without the flag the colleague gets the status.
- D-F5-8 GET /payment-attempts and payment create depend on require_portal_invoicing (404 INVOICING_DISABLED when invoicing is off), matching the design's gate order.
- D-F5-9 The factory refactor: both factories come from one module-level builder in bootstrap/agents.py so the webhook factory's behavior is unchanged and the portal factory is unit-testable (test_portal_stripe_factory.py imports it).
